translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai boht meharban hai
qasam hai unn ( hawaon ) ki jo aik kay baad aik bheji jati hain ,
phir jo aandhi ban ker zor say chalti hain ,
aur jo ( badalon ko ) khoob achi tarah phela deti hain ,
phir qasam hai unn ( farishton ) ki jo haq aur batil ko alag alag ker-detay hain ,
phir naseehat ki baaten nazil kertay hain ,
jo ya to logon  kay liye moaafi maangney ka sabab banti hain , ya daraney ka ,
yaqeenan woh waqiaa zaroor paish aa-ker rahey ga jiss ka tum say wada kiya jaraha hai .
chunacheh ( woh waqiaa uss waqt hoga ) jab sitaray bujha diye jayen gay ,
aur jab aasman ko cheer diya jaye ga ,
aur jab pahar reza reza kerdiye jayen gay ,
aur jab payghumberon kay jama honey ka waqt aajaye ga .
. ( koi poochay kay ) iss moamlay ko kiss din kay liye multawi kiya gaya hai ?
. ( to jawab yeh hai kay ) faislay kay din kay liye !
aur tumhen kiya maloom kay faislay ka din kiya cheez hai ?
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain
kiya hum ney pehlay logon  ko halak nahi kiya-?
phir unhi kay peechay baad walon ko bhi chalta kerden gay .
aisa hi sulook hum mujrimon kay sath kiya kertay hain .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
kiya hum ney tumhen aik haqeer paani say peda nahi kiya-?
phir hum ney ussay muqarrara waqt tak aik mazboot qarar ki jagah mein rakha ,
Ek muqarrar waqt tak
phir hum ney tawazun peda kiya , chunacheh acha tawazun peda kernay walay hum hain !
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
kiya hum ney zameen ko aisa nahi banaya kay woh samett ker rakhney wali hai ,
zindon ko bhi , aur murdon ko bhi ?
aur hum ney uss mein garray huye oonchay oonchay pahar peda kiye , aur tumhen meethay paani say sairaab kernay ka intizam kiya .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
. ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : )  chalo abb ussi cheez ki taraf jissay tum jhutlaya kertay thay .
chalo uss sayeban ki taraf jo teen shaakhon wala hai ,
jiss mein naa to ( thandak wala ) saya hai , aur naa woh aag ki lapat say bacha sakta hai .
woh aag to mehal jaisay baray baray sholay phenkay gi ,
aisa lagay ga jaisay woh zard rang kay oont hon .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
yeh aisa din hai jiss mein yeh log bol nahi saken gay ,
aur naa enhen iss baat ki ijazat hogi kay woh koi uzr paish ker-saken .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
yeh faislay ka din hai . hum ney tumhen aur pichlay logon  ko ikattha kerliya hai .
abb agar tumharay paas koi dao hai to mujh per woh dao chala lo .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
jinn logon  ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya , woh beyshak sayon aur chashmon kay darmiyan hon gay ,
aur apney mann pasand mewon kay darmiyan !
. ( unn say kaha jaye ga kay : ) mazay say khao , aur piyo unn aemal ki badolat jo tum kiya kertay thay .
hum naik logon  ko aisa hi sila detay hain .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
. ( aey kafiro ! ) kuch waqt khalo , aur mazay urra lo . haqeeqat mein tum log mujrim ho .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
aur jab inn logon  say kaha jata hai kay Allah kay aagay jhuk jao , to yeh jhuktay nahi hain .
bari kharabi hogi uss din aesay logon  ki jo haq ko jhutlatay hain .
abb iss kay baad aur kon si baat hai jiss per yeh emaan layen gay-?
